name: replan incrementally when costs change
mechanism: keep the previous search's cost information and, when an edge cost changes, repair only the affected part of the plan instead of searching from scratch

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'D*' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Graph search: an incremental heuristic search algorithm

fails_when: many simultaneous changes approach a full replan
